ShapeEngine

Class InputExtensions

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides extension methods for input-related types, such as device type filtering, input state retrieval, consumption, creation, and display name formatting.

Consumes the input state for a gamepad button on a specific gamepad.

The gamepad button to consume.

The index of the gamepad.

True if the state was valid and consumed; otherwise, false.
